name: Aero Commander 680/690 Jetprop (Gulfstream Commander)
manufacturer: Aero Commander / Rockwell / Gulfstream American / Twin Commander
summary: High-wing, pressurized-cabin twin turboprop descended from the Aero Commander piston twins and sold under Rockwell, Gulfstream American and Twin Commander names.

wings: High, straight wing with slight taper
Wing sits on top of the fuselage, so the cabin hangs beneath it
engines: Two Garrett turboprops in long slender nacelles mounted on the wing
Nacelles project well ahead of the wing leading edge
fuselage: Boxy, squared-off cabin with large, rectangular windows
Pointed nose with a flat sloping windshield
tail: Tall swept fin with a dorsal fillet
Conventional tailplane set low on the fuselage

tellTales: High wing on a boxy cabin with big rectangular windows
Two long slender turboprop nacelles reaching well ahead of the wing
Tall tail and a pointed nose on an otherwise slab-sided body

confusedWith.howToTell: The MU-2 has a cigar-shaped tube fuselage, stubby nacelles, a shoulder-mounted short wing and cylindrical tip tanks; the Commander is boxier with long nacelles and no tip tanks.
The King Air is a low-wing aircraft; the Commander is a high-wing aircraft with the cabin hanging beneath the wing.
The piston Aero Commander 500 has shorter nacelles with piston-engine cowls and a smaller cabin; the 690 has longer turboprop nacelles, a taller fin and a longer fuselage.
